metadata.title: SST, Chlorophyll, Wind Speed - Multi-Region (PLACEHOLDER)
metadata.source: PLACEHOLDER DATA - not real INCOIS/ISRO readings
metadata.note: These values are realistic-range mock data only, generated because INCOIS does not publicly expose numeric SST/Chlorophyll/Wind values without an approved MOSDAC (ISRO) account. Replace with real values once account is approved. Do not present this as real government data.
